dimensions.assessment: Affects tax whistleblowers, individuals participating in IRS award proceedings, tax attorneys, and IRS administrative operations.
dimensions.evidence: a whistleblower may elect to proceed anonymously before the Tax Court for all proceedings under this section

dimensions.assessment: Changes legal standards from abuse of discretion to de novo review in Tax Court, grants anonymity rights, and mandates interest on overdue awards.
dimensions.evidence: Any review by the Tax Court under the preceding sentence shall be de novo and shall be based on the administrative record

dimensions.assessment: Requires interest payments on mandatory whistleblower awards if notices are delayed and alters tax deduction rules for attorney fees, with potential federal revenue and payout adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: the amount of any award under this subsection shall include interest from such date at the overpayment rate under section 6621(a).

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 regarding whistleblower review procedures, privacy protections, report contents, and tax deductions.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to make improvements with respect to the treatment of whistleblowers, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Institutes permanent statutory modifications to IRS whistleblower rules, award reviews, and tax deduction criteria.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to petitions under section 7623(b)(4)... pending on, or filed on or after, the date of the enactment

missing_information: The total fiscal cost of interest payments and tax deductions resulting from the bill is not estimated in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: The IRS Whistleblower Program Improvement Act modifies tax whistleblower award review standards in Tax Court, provides anonymity protections, requires interest payments on delayed awards, and adjusts tax deductions for whistleblower attorney fees.

card.summary: The Taxpayer Assistance and Service Act (TAS Act) aims to improve taxpayer services provided by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS). The bill establishes new technological tools for taxpayers and tax professionals, updates IRS procedures regarding collections, appeals, and penalties, modifies rules for tax return preparers and whistleblowers, expands the authority and jurisdiction of the U.S. Tax Court, and provides specific relief for Americans abroad, hostages, and small businesses.
